en.abdullah-al-shahin: (3) The previous narrators narrated from Muhammad bin Sinan from Abdullah bin Miskan that Malik al-Juhani had said:

“I said to Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as): “We describe the man of this matter (al-Qa’im) with the aspects that no one of the people has ever had.” He said: “No, By Allah, it is not so. It is he himself, who will argue with you about that and will invite you to it.”
